title: The Clairaudiograph
subtitle: A voice cut into wax
text: The Mnemonist teaches this at Degree 3 after three personal sample identifications and the Alchemist's referral. Load a filled creature Blood Vial and a blank Wax, Ambergris or Corpse Wax Cylinder. Choose a call and carve for four seconds. Identification is optional. The blood is consumed and its empty vial remains. Preview is private. Play reaches up to 32 blocks. A rising redstone edge plays once. Loop repeats while powered or after you press Play. Stop affects only this machine. Make two Wax Cylinders from honeycomb, Active Befouling Ash and paper. Make one Corpse Wax Cylinder from two Adipocere, a Hematic Iron Scrap, Active Befouling Ash and paper.
